verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs, a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, and an official MCP server, but nothing shows an official LangSmith command-line interface. These are adjacent programmatic surfaces, not a CLI, and an observability platform could plausibly ship one, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
